title: DM reply text duplicated and visually ugly
summary: The owner asked to fix duplicated DM reply text, merge and push the fix, and check phone and desktop; simulated replying-state capture could be skipped. The Product Development Lead reported fix commit 2f4a7b1 pushed to origin/main and phone/desktop screenshots showing clean paragraphs/lists and no grey reply band. The owner instruction was satisfied. The dynamic mid-stream screenshot was intentionally skipped per instruction; the regression test covers that case. No release/deployment evidence was provided.
nextAction: None for this thread. No matching canonical task was found in the supplied tasks snapshot. Do not infer deployment from origin/main; no release request remains open here.

Thread reply post_01a0f11c-8d49-74d0-9bd9-a08833edc3d2 reports phone and desktop screenshots, the owner-approved skip of simulated replying state, and that the fix was pushed.
